headlines.title: Maye Musk talks her children and the long road toward success
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi sits down with model and author Maye Musk to discuss her incredible journey of escaping an abusive marriage and raising three highly successful children, including Elon Musk.

headlines.title: Analysts rank eToro 11 spots above PayPal
headlines.summary: PayPal turns out to be the biggest loser in the Roundtable 100 this week.

headlines.title: PayPal Announces Meta Muse Partnership. It’s a Lifeline for the Stock.
headlines.summary: PayPal  customers can now use Meta’s Muse artificial-intelligence consumer agent to shop and check out, PayPal said Tuesday.  Shares of PayPal rose 0.5% to $52.90 after the announcement.  Meta Platforms  stock fell 0.4% to $738.53.

headlines.title: New Track Rabbit Feature: Payments Your Way Just Got Even Better
headlines.summary: Track Rabbit, the marketing-based event registration, member management, and administrative e-commerce platform for automotive enthusiasts and the motorsport industry, has announced another new flexible payment option for event organizers.

headlines.title: PayPal Joins Meta’s Muse Checkout Ecosystem — Partnership Extends AI Shopping Across Its Merchant Network
headlines.summary: The Meta tie-up puts PayPal alongside Shopify and Stripe in Muse’s growing commerce ecosystem as the AI agent rapidly builds a consumer audience.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
